For Respondent(s) UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R Heard Mr. Imran Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner.
He submits that the petitioner is aged about 68 years and was the Salesman in the shop where the Adulterated Namkeen was found to have been sold.
The owner of the shop has however, been acquitted.
For the conviction under the Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act, 1954, the petitioner was sentenced to six months imprisonment and remained in custody for 15 days, before bail.

CORAM :
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HRISHIKESH ROY [IN CHAMBER]
He submits that the petitioner is aged about 68 years and was the Salesman in the shop where the Adulterated Namkeen was found to have been sold.
The owner of the shop has however, been acquitted.
For the conviction under the Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act, 1954, the petitioner was sentenced to six months imprisonment and remained in custody for 15 days, before bail.
Projecting the age factor and the current Pandemic situation, the counsel prays for exemption from surrendering.
The petitioner-Gopal Pal is exempted from surrendering.
(INDU MARWAH) (DIPTI KHURANA)
